Fight_Guard.prompt: A person holds a sword in the right hand and a shield in front of the chest with the left arm, and stands in a fighting stance, shifting the weight from foot to foot.

Fight_Strafe_R.prompt: A person holds a sword in the right hand and a shield in front of the chest with the left arm, and side-steps to the right.

Fight_Strafe_L.prompt: A person holds a sword in the right hand and a shield in front of the chest with the left arm, and side-steps to the left.

Fight_Slash.prompt: A swordsman cuts diagonally down across his body with his right arm, from high on the right to low on the left.

Fight_Backhand.prompt: A swordsman swings his right arm across from his left shoulder out to the right in a flat, fast cut.

Fight_Chop.prompt: A swordsman raises his right arm high above his head and cuts straight down in front of him.

Fight_Block.prompt: A person holds a sword in the right hand and a shield in front of the chest with the left arm, and raises the shield to block a heavy blow and is pushed back a step.

Fight_Dodge.prompt: A person holds a sword in the right hand and a shield in front of the chest with the left arm, and quickly ducks and jumps to the left side to dodge, then stands back up.
